Package org.cha0scollective.wwpg.api.cee

Record Class CeeElectricalParameters

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.cha0scollective.wwpg.api.cee.CeeElectricalParameters
public record CeeElectricalParameters(double conductanceSiemens, double currentSourceAmps, double voltageSourceVolts, boolean idealVoltageSource) extends Record
Immutable CEE-native two-terminal parameters. Conductance is nonnegative siemens. currentSourceAmps uses CEE's current-source convention; voltageSourceVolts uses CEE's native source polarity. These values correspond directly to CEE ElectricalProperties getters; WWPG handles the polarity change for PG. idealVoltageSource keeps the ideal constraint present at a zero crossing.

  • Constructor Details

    • CeeElectricalParameters

      public CeeElectricalParameters(double conductanceSiemens, double currentSourceAmps, double voltageSourceVolts, boolean idealVoltageSource)
      Constructs CeeElectricalParameters with validated captured values.
      Parameters:
      conductanceSiemens - conductance in siemens, finite in [0, 1e15] inclusive
      currentSourceAmps - CEE-native signed source current in amperes; finite, with magnitude at most 1e15 (inclusive)
      voltageSourceVolts - CEE-native signed source voltage in volts; finite, with magnitude at most 1e15 (inclusive)
      idealVoltageSource - must be true for nonzero voltageSourceVolts; retain true for ideal-source zero crossings
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a numeric, key, count or structural constraint is violated
